name: Segue Manufacturing Services LLC
old_description: Lorom, In-Tech Electronics, and Segue Manufacturing Services are now Lisconn — a new name that reflects our shared 100 years of experience in electronics, engineering, and interconnect innovation. Backed by Cornell Capital, Lisconn brings together the expertise of three industry leaders under one trusted brand.
about:
Segue Manufacturing Services operates from North Billerica, Massachusetts, just outside Boston. The company established operations in 1991 with the goal of getting customers' products to market while exceeding expectations. It is a U.S.-owned and operated business backed by private equity firm Cornell Capital. In 2024, Segue joined with Lorom and In-Tech Electronics to form Lisconn, a combined entity reflecting a shared 100 years of experience in electronics, engineering, and interconnect innovation.

As a global contract manufacturer, Segue integrates engineering services with manufacturing operations in Boston, Tijuana (Mexico), and Xiamen (China), plus partner factories in Malaysia and India. The company provides capabilities scaling from sub-assembly level to complete end-to-end manufacturing, including prototype fabrication, new product introduction, domestic stocking and replenishment, and quality systems. Its vertically integrated model combines local engineering and customer service with cost-effective global production.

Segue serves OEMs and Tier 1 electronics manufacturing services customers across highly regulated sectors. Its industry expertise spans medical devices and healthcare, industrial automation and robotics, capital equipment and semiconductor, industrial and IoT, instrumentation, energy and environmental, and aerospace and defense. The company focuses on complex electronic products where it has deep assembly experience.

Segue differentiates itself through right-shoring flexibility, offering customers the benefits of local engineering support combined with manufacturing where it makes economic sense. The company emphasizes proactive customer service, real-time testing systems, and common manufacturing platforms that enable rapid transitions without compromising quality. It only takes on projects where it has the experience to deliver successfully, aiming to lower inventory carrying costs while maintaining exceptional delivery performance.
